title: 12 Best Kottu Roti in Colombo
description: The best kottu roti spots in Colombo, Sri Lanka — curated from Reddit. Late-night street kottu, cheese kottu, bacon kottu and upscale reinventions.

items.verdict: The bacon cheese kottu that converted purists into believers

items.name: Culture Colombo

items.name: Coffee Colombo

items.name: Hotel de Plaza

items.name: JD's Kitchen
